question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**which**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use a **relative pronoun** as there is a noun before the blank.
 
• We need to use the relative pronoun **which **in this case.
 
• we use **which **we are referring to objects, things or organisations
 
 
• Example: *The ministry of Ayush **which __**is a ministry of alternate medicine issued guidelines for the prevention and treatment of covid-19.*
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3**

**The complete passage is-** *The air has become very dirty in **(1) many** parts of the world. This is of course **(2) harmful** to your health. Experts say many people die** (3) from** it each year. There is a new study on **(4) air** pollution which comes from the experts of the World Health Organization (WHO) **(5) which** is an agency of the United Nations. If you **(6) inhale** unhealthy air for long periods of time, you could **(7) become** sick. Air pollution has been linked to many diseases **(8) like** stroke and cancer. The WHO says that seven million **(9) people** die each year as a result of the **(10) polluted** air.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** *

 
• The use of relative pronouns.
 
• We use who when referring to people or animals
 
• We use **whom **also to refer to human subjects.
 
• We use **what **to refer to things.
